⬆️ Tactical Upgrade: From Red-Maned to Blue-Maned
蓝鬃的基础 AI 逻辑和红鬃是一模一样的。面对 3000 血的蓝鬃，如果直接硬刚会非常消耗武器耐久，依然建议使用爆头骑乘流：

The Blue-Maned Lynel's basic AI logic is exactly the same as the Red-Maned version's. Against a 3,000 HP Blue-Maned Lynel, fighting head-on will burn through weapon durability fast, so the headshot-and-mount strategy is still recommended:
🔁 核心循环（与红鬃完全一致）
🔁 Core Loop (identical to the Red-Maned version)
盾反或躲招创造机会
Parry or dodge to create an opening
弓箭爆头面部
Bow headshot to the face
跪地后上马白嫖 5 刀（不耗耐久）
Mount after it kneels for 5 free hits (no durability cost)
甩飞后空中拉弓补刀
After being thrown off, shoot follow-up arrows midair
重复
Repeat
💡 与红鬃的差异：血量更厚（3000 vs 2000），同样的循环需要多打 1～2 轮。伤害也有提升，失误被砍中会更疼，多备回血料理。
💡 Difference from the Red-Maned version: more HP (3,000 vs 2,000), so the same loop takes 1–2 extra rounds. Its damage is also higher, so a mistimed hit hurts more — bring extra healing meals.

⚠️ 必须警惕的新招式
⚠️ New Moves to Watch Out For
《荒野之息》中，部分蓝鬃会手持兽王大剑或兽王枪，攻击轨迹与单手剑完全不同，需要特别应对：

In Breath of the Wild, some Blue-Maned Lynels carry a Savage Lynel Sword (greatsword) or Savage Lynel Spear, whose attack arcs are completely different from a one-handed sword and need special counters:
大剑
Greatsword
蓄力回旋斩
Charged spin slash
前兆：把大剑背在身后，原地蓄力，然后像大风车一样原地转圈。 ⚠ 危险：此招判定范围极大，极不推荐尝试硬碰硬闪避。 应对方案 A：看到它蓄力，立刻拔腿往后跑，拉开足够的安全距离，等动作结束后再靠近。 应对方案 B（更推荐）：在它蓄力的瞬间，用弓箭精准爆头打断，不仅规避危险还直接创造骑乘机会。

Tell: it holds the greatsword behind its back, charges in place, then spins in circles like a whirlwind. ⚠ Danger: this move's hitbox is enormous — dodging it head-on is strongly discouraged. Counter A: the moment you see it charge, run straight back to a safe distance and approach again after the move ends. Counter B (recommended): the instant it charges, land a precise bow headshot to interrupt it — this avoids the danger and directly creates a mounting opportunity.

前兆：高高跳起，将长枪砸向地面引发范围冲击波。 应对：看到它跳起，立刻往侧方奔跑并接一个跳跃躲开落点冲击波。 反击时机：等它落地后有明显硬直，这是极好的拉弓爆头时机——比任何其他招式都更容易创造跪地机会。

Tell: it leaps high and slams its spear into the ground, creating an area shockwave. Counter: the moment you see it jump, run sideways and jump to dodge the impact shockwave. Counterattack window: after it lands it has an obvious stagger — an excellent moment to draw your bow for a headshot, easier than any other move for creating a kneeling opening.

🚀 《王国之泪》专属逃票科技
🚀 Tears of the Kingdom Exclusive Cheese Tactics
如果你玩的是《王国之泪》，面对蓝鬃莱尼尔你有更多神奇的"科技"可以轻松搞定它：
If you play Tears of the Kingdom, you have more amazing "tech" to deal with a Blue-Maned Lynel easily:
盾牌火箭——拿回制空权，瞬间起飞 在盾牌上余料建造一个火箭或弹簧。战斗开始时，按住 ZL 举盾直接飞上高空，完全脱离地面危险范围，从天上俯瞰人马。

Shield rocket — take back the skies and launch instantly. Fuse a rocket or spring to your shield. At the start of the fight, hold ZL to raise your shield and fly straight up, completely leaving the ground danger zone and looking down on the Lynel from above.

🍖 进场前的强化建议
🍖 Pre-Fight Buff Recommendations
3 级防御料理（强烈推荐）：用 4 个铁蘑菇 + 1 个龙角，或者 5 个铠甲草熬制。 这样即使不小心失误被蓝鬃挥中一刀，也只会掉一两颗心，容错率极高，大幅降低新手失误的代价。

Level-3 defense meals (strongly recommended): cook with 4 Ironshrooms + 1 dragon horn, or 5 Armoranths. Even if you slip up and take a hit from the Blue-Maned Lynel, you will only lose one or two hearts — extremely forgiving, greatly reducing the cost of beginner mistakes.

Arrow stockpile: bring 30 or more regular arrows (it has 1,000 more HP than the Red-Maned version, so more headshots are needed), plus some Keese eyeballs (for Tears of the Kingdom) as insurance for homing headshots.
骑乘专用武器：准备一把近卫双手剑融合高攻素材，砍到快折断红血状态后上马使用，伤害翻倍且不消耗耐久，是最高效的骑乘输出武器。

Dedicated mounted weapon: prepare a Royal Guard's Claymore fused with a high-attack material, worn down to its nearly broken red-health state before mounting — double damage with no durability cost, the most efficient mounted damage weapon.
